scores.evidence: Both tables (s2-table, s5-table) stay readable at 390 px as two columns, and the code blocks, steps and prompt blocks render cleanly. In the s2-layers diagram, though, the edges are drawn through the subgraph titles 「VM・クラウドセッション」 and 「サンドボックス」 (pages/desktop-jp-04.png, desktop-jp-05.png, mobile-jp-06.png, mobile-jp-07.png).

No screen is text-only (textOnlyScreens is empty), and a check, table, diagram or code block appears on almost every screen. s5-md2 packs four facts into one paragraph block (mobile-jp-13.png). The desktop median of 44 chars per line is above the 30–40 target, and that comes from the reader's measure.

All visible text, including the diagram labels, is Japanese, with no stray English UI. Text contrast is good, and no line breaks inside Japanese words were seen. Quiz options and buttons stay clear of the top and bottom bars on mobile (mobile-jp-05.png, mobile-jp-25.png).
